acceptanceCriteria: An opt-in flag or policy member copies built-in merge attributes and rename config into the probe; external merge/filter drivers are never honoured.
A test shows merge=union resolves where the default reports conflict, and a custom driver still never runs.
body: Residual from V1-1710 review fix (PR #1097). To stay read-only, the dry merge now runs with no repository config or attributes, so built-in attribute drivers (merge=union, merge=binary, -merge) and rename settings are ignored; it can report a conflict the repository would resolve (recorded in SPC-V0-003 as a conservative approximation). Expected: an opt-in mode that copies only built-in-driver attributes and rename config into the probe, never external drivers.
title: sharedpath dry merge: optionally honour built-in .gitattributes merge settings (union, binary) and rename config safely
